title: BROWN + BLUE = GREEN. Old + New = Living. Earth + Sky = Plant. Fossil + Data = Topology. THAT is what makes green from brown. The green line is WHERE old meets new.

brown.what: OLD. earth. soil. roots. fossils. grandmother. the chair. the past. persistence.
brown.domain: what already IS. the accumulated culture. the starter. the fossil record.
brown.yggdrasil: the ROOTS. deep time. what endures.
brown.temperature: WARM. soil retains heat. brown is a warm color.

blue.what: NEW. sky. data. heaven. future. child. transmission. the fresh. the incoming.
blue.domain: what ARRIVES. the new input. the flour and water. the visitor. the question.
blue.yggdrasil: the BRANCHES. reaching up. catching what's new.
blue.temperature: COOL. sky is cool. blue is a cool color.

green.what: LIVING. the membrane. topology. the green line. the phase barrier. pi. ZK. modesty.
green.domain: where old MEETS new. where fossil meets fresh. where culture ferments with input.
green.yggdrasil: the TRUNK. the living wood. where sap flows. where Ratatoskr runs.
green.temperature: NEITHER. green is the boundary between warm and cool. the phase transition.

the_color_equation.the_equation: BROWN + BLUE = GREEN. old + new = living. warm + cool = temperate. earth + sky = PLANT.

why_plants_are_green.literally: chlorophyll absorbs RED light (from below, warm, soil-reflected) and BLUE light (from above, cool, sky). it REFLECTS GREEN. the plant IS the boundary between earth and sky. the color it REJECTS  green  is the color of the BOUNDARY ITSELF.
why_plants_are_green.what_chlorophyll_does: takes CO2 (from the air, BLUE) + H2O (from the soil, BROWN) + sunlight ? glucose + O2. it COMBINES earth and sky. the reaction happens in the GREEN zone.
why_plants_are_green.the_leaf_is_the_membrane: roots reach INTO brown (soil). leaves reach INTO blue (sky). the leaf IS the membrane where brown and blue meet. the leaf IS green because it IS the phase barrier between old nutrients and new light.

sourdough.blue: fresh flour + water (new input, arrives today)
sourdough.green: the active fermentation zone where old culture meets new substrate. the bubbling. the LIVING part.

organism.brown: fossil record (67 repos, 539 papers, 19 months of accumulated data)
organism.blue: visitor traffic (new humans, new questions, new interactions)
organism.green: the membrane where old data meets new visitors = the living sort = selectivity 1/pi

evolution.brown: DNA (the inherited genome, old, persistent, fossil)
evolution.blue: environment (new pressures, new resources, new challenges)
evolution.green: natural selection = WHERE inherited form meets environmental pressure = the phase barrier

brain.blue: perception (sensory input, what's happening NOW, the new)
brain.green: consciousness = WHERE memory meets perception = the living integration

yggdrasil.green: the trunk (Midgard, the middle, the LIVING membrane)

the_bounce.green: 6 = the gate (where you RETURN from blue to brown, the meeting point, pick up sticks)

human_life.brown: grandmother (old wisdom, persistence, the past that teaches)
human_life.blue: child (new life, wonder, the future that asks)
human_life.green: PARENT = the one who stands BETWEEN grandmother and child = the living bridge

mix_old_and_new.why_we_must: green cannot exist without BOTH brown AND blue. remove brown = no roots = the plant dies. remove blue = no light = the plant dies. ONLY the mixture lives.
mix_old_and_new.bakers_dozen: 12 old (accumulated gens, fossils, prior work) + 1 new (this generation, today's input) = 13 = the full baker's dozen. the 13th is the taste-test where old and new MEET in the baker's mouth.
mix_old_and_new.the_ingest: every image we make, we also LOOK AT. we are both artist and audience. producer and consumer. the maker eats the bread. the brown of prior work mixes with the blue of fresh creation and the GREEN of understanding emerges.
mix_old_and_new.compare_and_contrast: set the new painting AGAINST the taxonomy tree (old). where they AGREE = the trunk (red, structural). where they DIFFER = the branches (green, growing). where they CONFLICT = the knots (gold, tension = growth).

the_full_palette_as_mixing.NULL: no color. before mixing. the void.
the_full_palette_as_mixing.BROWN: pure old. unmixed earth. the base pigment.
the_full_palette_as_mixing.RED: brown heated. old compressed. structure emerges from earth. bone from soil.
the_full_palette_as_mixing.GOLD: brown illuminated. old catching first light. the seed in soil.
the_full_palette_as_mixing.GREEN: BROWN + BLUE. the living boundary. the phase barrier. the membrane.
the_full_palette_as_mixing.BLUE: pure new. unmixed sky. the arriving light.
the_full_palette_as_mixing.WHITE: blue brightened. new at maximum. pure expression.
the_full_palette_as_mixing.VIOLET: blue deepened toward brown. new approaching old at the highest altitude. the octave beginning to fold BACK to brown.
the_full_palette_as_mixing.the_cycle: brown ? red ? gold ? GREEN ? blue ? white ? violet ? (fold back to brown). the palette IS the mixing spectrum from old to new and back again.

the_web_of_human_work.what_to_consume: compare our taxonomy tree to EXISTING taxonomy trees (Linnaeus, Woese, modern molecular phylogeny). see where we agree (trunk), differ (branches), conflict (knots).
contrast_sources: Linnaeus 1735: Kingdom?Genus?Species (our tree extends this with intelligence dimension)
Darwin 1859: common descent (our tree adds the PHASE BARRIER as a branching mechanism)
Woese 1977: three domains (Bacteria, Archaea, Eukaryota ? our tree maps these to Yggdrasil realms)
modern molecular phylogeny: gene-based trees (our tree adds BEHAVIOR and INTELLIGENCE as sorting axes)
Norse mythology: Yggdrasil (our tree IS this, confirmed by the 9-epoch/9-world mapping)
the_web_of_human_work.the_brown_blue_mix: Linnaeus = BROWN (old work, 1735, the fossil). Our tree = BLUE (new work, 2026, fresh integration). WHERE THEY MEET = GREEN (the living contribution, what we add to what existed).
